data.title: A line of light behind the glass
data.goal: A line of light behind the glass

memoryNodes.cue: A gauge and barometer show readings.
memoryNodes.cueZh: 仪表与气压计显示读数。

data.situation:
At the optical display, a line of light crossed a fixed lens and reached a white disc. The laser was enclosed behind glass, with the controls out of visitors’ reach. A small board called the subject optics. Jo moved along the outside of the case to see where the light ended. On the adjoining instrument shelf, a gauge had a needle and numbered marks. The barometer beside it measured air pressure. Maya sketched the round disc and the two instrument faces; similar shapes did not mean that they had the same job. Jo: Is that disc measuring the air pressure?
Attendant: No. The barometer does that.
Maya: Can we adjust the laser?
Attendant: Visitors can observe the optical display from here. The controls remain inside the case.

A small board called the subject optics. Jo moved along the outside of the case to see where the light ended. On the adjoining instrument shelf, a gauge had a needle and numbered marks. The barometer beside it measured air pressure. Maya sketched the round disc and the two instrument faces; similar shapes did not mean that they had the same job.
readingBlocks.zh: 光学展台上，一束光穿过固定透镜，落到白色圆盘上。激光装置封闭在玻璃后，控制器不供游客触及。小展牌把这一学科称为光学。乔沿柜外移动，查看光落在何处。相邻的仪表架上，仪表有指针和数字刻度，旁边的气压计测量气压。玛雅画下圆盘和两个仪表表面；形状相似不代表用途相同。

readingBlocks.zh:
乔：圆盘在测气压吗？
工作人员：不是，气压计做这件事。
玛雅：我们能调整激光吗？
工作人员：游客在这里观察光学展台，控制器留在柜内。

glossary.note: 形容词，如 optical equipment、optical effects。

externalEvidence.definition: of or relating to or involving light or optics

glossary.zh: 使光线会聚或发散的透镜
glossary.note: 可数名词：a lens，复数 lenses；这里指仪器的透镜。
glossary.example: Light passed through a fixed lens.

externalEvidence.definition: a transparent optical device used to converge or diverge transmitted light and to form images

glossary.zh: 研究光及其性质的光学
glossary.note: 学科名称，通常配单数动词：optics is…。

externalEvidence.definition: the branch of physics that studies the physical properties of light

glossary.zh: 产生高度集中的光束的激光装置
glossary.note: 这里指激光装置；a laser beam 指它发出的激光束。

externalEvidence.definition: an acronym for light amplification by stimulated emission of radiation; an optical device that produces an intense monochromatic beam of coherent light

glossary.note: 这里是薄圆盘；用 a disc、two discs。
glossary.example: The light reached a white disc.

glossary.zh: 显示某种测量数值的仪表
glossary.note: 测量仪表名词；a pressure gauge 是压力表。
glossary.example: The gauge had a needle and numbered marks.
glossary.exampleZh: 仪表带指针和数字刻度。

externalEvidence.definition: a measuring instrument for measuring and indicating a quantity such as the thickness of wire or the amount of rain etc.

glossary.zh: 测量大气压力的气压计
glossary.note: 测量气压的仪器；也可比喻反映变化的“晴雨表”。

externalEvidence.definition: an instrument that measures atmospheric pressure
